Container.Name: spoolroom-watcher
Container.Overview: The Spoolroom watcher notices finished 3D prints on your network and logs them into your Spoolroom, deducting filament from the right spools. It only makes outbound connections: to your printers and to spoolroom.app. 1) Get a watcher token in Spoolroom: Settings, Connections, Connect a Watcher, and paste it below. 2) After the container starts, click its icon, choose Console, and run spoolroom-setup to find and add your printers. The watcher keeps itself up to date.
Container.Requires: A Spoolroom account and a watcher token (swt_...).

Config.Name: State
Config.Description: Watcher state (watermarks, lock, remote-access sign-in). Do not change it after the first run, or prints re-import.

Config.Name: Watcher token
Config.Description: From Spoolroom: Settings, Connections, Connect a Watcher. Starts with swt_. Treat it like a password.
